facts.note: Applies only to pay for services performed to carry out the purpose of the F/J/M/Q admission (IRS Pub. 515 (2026) agrees, incl. authorized CPT/OPT); employee and employer FICA both not due. Level: payroll withholding and employer contribution.

facts.value: Exempt: pay of a nonresident alien in F-1, J-1, M-1 or Q status for services that carry out the purpose of admission, on or off campus, including authorized Curricular and Optional Practical Training. Not exempt: other employment of the same person (e.g. an unrelated part-time job), and any pay once the person is a resident alien.

facts.note: IRC 3306(c)(19) and IRS Pub. 515 (2026): wages of F/J/M/Q nonresident aliens are not subject to FUTA. State UI coverage follows each state statute separately.
Nonresident aliens on other nonimmigrant visas (e.g. H-1B, L-1) or in refugee/asylee status are fully liable for social security and Medicare unless a totalization agreement exemption applies.

facts.value: Wages are exempt from employee FICA (IRC 3101(c)) and employer FICA (IRC 3111(c)) while a section 233 Social Security Act agreement is in effect, to the extent the agreement makes them subject exclusively to the foreign social security system.
facts.note: Employer FICA counterpart: IRC 3111(c) (register US-FEDR2-004). The list of agreements in force and the certificate-of-coverage procedure are SSA documents not held locally (see unresolved).
